skill.name: release-orchestrator
skill.description: Coordinate software release preparation, rollout readiness, migration notes, rollback planning, stakeholder communication, and final go/no-go release packets. Use when asked to prepare a release packet, review release readiness, or turn scattered launch notes into one reusable release workflow. Do not use for generic project planning, one-off announcement drafting, or high-level release theory.
skill.summary: Coordinate release readiness into a complete go/no-go packet.
skill.author: yaojingang

content.value_statement: Release teams often have scattered notes, unclear rollback criteria, and missing communication plans. This skill turns those inputs into a structured release packet with readiness gates and go/no-go guidance.
actual_capabilities: Collects release scope, risky changes, migrations, rollout sequence, rollback triggers, and communication audiences.
Applies the release checklist to require summary, dependencies, migrations, rollout, rollback, communication, and final decision.
Uses the risk matrix to classify low, medium, high, and critical release concerns.
Creates audience-specific messages for engineering, support, operations, and leadership.
Can use the bundled Python helper to render a deterministic markdown release packet.
limitations: Requires accurate release inputs from the user or repository notes.
Does not deploy software, execute migrations, or monitor live systems.
Does not replace approvals from release managers, incident owners, or compliance teams.
Not intended for single announcements, brainstorming, or general release education.

use_cases.title: Readiness Review
use_cases.description: Turn scattered launch notes into one packet before an approval meeting.

use_cases.title: Migration Launch Planning
use_cases.description: Verify migration timing, rollback expectations, and operator warnings before traffic shift.

use_cases.title: Stakeholder Alignment
use_cases.description: Prepare audience-specific messages tied to release timing and risk.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Packet
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a release packet from these notes. Include scope, risks, migrations, rollout, rollback, stakeholder messages, and a final decision.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner release packet from raw notes.

prompt_templates.title: Check Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this planned release for readiness. Flag missing inputs, unresolved risks, weak rollback criteria, and the recommended go or no-go decision.

prompt_templates.title: Add Migration Detail
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a release packet for this schema change. Include timing, rollback safety, owner warnings, and communication needs.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Complex Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these service, migration, risk, rollout, rollback, and audience notes into a final release packet. Mark conditions required before approval.

output_examples.input: Scattered notes for a search service migration and staged rollout.
output: Scope summary for the search hardening release.
Risk block with high migration timing risk and medium latency risk.
Rollout, rollback, stakeholder messages, and GO WITH CONDITIONS decision.

output_examples.input: Release readiness review with missing rollback criteria.
output_examples.output: The skill reports the missing rollback trigger as a blocker and recommends NO-GO until criteria are defined.

output_examples.input: Customer-facing feature release with support and leadership updates.
output: Audience-specific communication plan for support and leadership.
Release window, impact surface, escalation signal, and final decision summary.

best_practices: Provide migration details, rollback thresholds, monitoring signals, and named owners before requesting a final decision.
Treat unresolved high or critical risks as blockers unless mitigations and gates are explicit.
Review the stakeholder communication block with each audience owner before release approval.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a GO decision when rollback triggers or migration timing are unknown.
Do not use the skill for a single announcement without a release packet workflow.
Do not treat generated packets as a substitute for deployment checks or human approval.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces a structured release packet with scope, risks, migrations, rollout, rollback, communications, and a go/no-go decision.

faq.question: Does it run deployments?
faq.answer: No. It prepares planning and readiness artifacts. It does not deploy code or change infrastructure.

faq.question: Can it handle migrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes migration type, affected surface, timing, rollback safety, and operator warnings when data changes exist.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is packaged for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should I avoid using it?
faq.answer: Avoid it for basic release theory, one short announcement, or early brainstorming without a repeatable workflow.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide scope, risks, migration notes, rollout steps, rollback triggers, audiences, owners, and release timing.
